articles.title: Westbound Hwy. 403 closed in Mississauga due to 3-vehicle crash
articles.summary: The westbound lanes of Highway 403 are closed in Mississauga for a collision involving three vehicles, Ontario Provincial Police (OPP) say. Emergency services are on the scene and at least two people have suffered serious injuries in the crash. The highway is closed between Mavis Road and Erin Mills Parkway and traffic delays are expected […]

articles.title: Mayoral hopeful Brad Bradford vows to remove Bloor Street W. bike lanes if elected
articles.summary: Toronto mayoral candidate Brad Bradford is promising the removal of bike lanes on a west-end street should he win the city’s top job.

articles.summary: Toronto police officers are trying to identify a suspect after a Facebook Marketplace seller was sprayed with a noxious substance during a robbery attempt. articles.title: Man charged after allegedly assaulting Toronto parking enforcement officer over ticket
articles.summary: A 34-year-old Toronto man has been charged after he allegedly assaulted a Toronto Police Parking Enforcement Officer (PEO) in North York on Sunday. articles.title: Toronto man arrested for alleged assault in Little India area
articles.summary: A Toronto man is facing charges in connection with an alleged assault that took place in the Little India area of Toronto last week. Police officers responded to a call for an assault in the the Coxwell Avenue and Gerrard Street East area around 10 p.m. on Aug. 7. The victim and suspect reportedly got […]

articles.title: Toronto police seek public's help in search for missing 63-year-old woman
articles.summary: Police are seeking the public's help in their search for a missing 63-year-old woman, identified as Ann Marie, who was last seen in North York Saturday.

articles.title: 'Everyone is chipping in to make this happen': Toronto charity building micro-shelter village in Scarborough
articles.summary: Tiny Tiny Homes, a Toronto charity that builds mobile and emergency shelters to those experiencing homelessness, is building a micro-shelter village in Scarborough that will provide transitional housing to 10 people by the end of this year.

articles.title: Markham hosts the IndyCar race for the 1st time. Here's what to expect
articles.summary: The City of Markham is hosting the IndyCar race for the first time this weekend. CBC’s Greg Ross gives you a first look at what to expect.

articles.title: Ontario to restore Brampton's Heart Lake Conservation Park at price tag of $1.2M
articles.summary: The provincial government announced Monday it will be taking on a restoration project at the Heart Lake Conservation Park in Brampton, Ont.

articles.title: Citing overcrowding, Mississauga animal services runs $25 adoption blitz
articles.summary: In an effort to ease overcrowding, Mississauga Animal Services Shelter says it's running a $25 dog and cat adoption blitz until the end of August.

articles.title: Toronto Liberal MP Shaun Chen to resign following car accident last year
articles.summary: Liberal MP Shaun Chen says he plans to resign at the end of this week. The Scarborough North MP issued a statement on social media saying injuries sustained in a car accident in late 2025 have prevented him from travelling to Ottawa as often as the job requires.

articles.title: SIU investigating Pickering, Ont., crash involving police cruiser, civilian vehicle
articles.summary: The province's police watchdog is investigating after a police cruiser and a civilian vehicle crashed in Pickering, Ont., Friday.

articles.title: 3rd man arrested in Toronto synagogue shooting investigation: York police
articles.summary: A Barrie man has been arrested as part of an investigation into synagogues being shot at in Vaughan and Toronto earlier this year, police say.
